load.heapMetric: process.memoryUsage().heapUsed peak sampled during the first snapshot, payload reads and operations
load.allocationMetric: peak live JavaScriptCore heap growth over the pre-operation heapSize baseline, sampled every 512 payload parses and at operation end; this captures concurrent heap pressure, while cumulative allocation volume remains unmeasured
load.scope: Viewer registry executor and Viewer loop monitor in isolation; no browser or whole-application traffic
